summary: A workspace form with a side column: a live preview, the plan's seat count and a completion checklist beside the fields.
use: Settings and edit pages on wide screens that should fill the width with context (preview, help, status) instead of stretching the fields.
spec: `<AppForm title="Workspace" description="Name, address and plan." asideLabel="Preview and help">` with `<FormSection title="General" description="How the workspace appears to your team.">` holding `<TextField label="Name" bind:value={name} />`, `<TextField label="Address" bind:value={slug} />` and `<Select label="Plan" bind:value={plan} options={planOptions} />`
`planOptions` has 3 entries: Free, Team, Business, with `let plan = $state('team')`; `seats` is 3, 25 or 250 by plan

`{#snippet aside()}` holds three Cards with `headingLevel={2}`: Preview (name in `<strong>` and `app.example.com/{slug || '…'}`), Plan (`<Stat label="Seats included" value={seats} size="sm" />`) and Checklist (`<Stepper {steps} current={Math.min(done, steps.length - 1)} />` with 3 steps)
`{#snippet footer()}` has Cancel with `variant="ghost"` and Save with `variant="filled"`
